specs.title: TC-001 new customer booking is saved as pending and shows the confirmation screen
TC-002 (revised) a returning phone number is NOT recognised and nothing is pre-filled
TC-003 Monday cannot be selected
TC-004 after the 5pm cutoff, today is not selectable (tomorrow is the earliest)
TC-004b control: before the cutoff, today can still be chosen
TC-005 price follows the stylist's tier
TC-006 a slot inside another booking's rest window is available if the service fits
TC-007 / TC-008 a clashing slot is unavailable and shown greyed out, not hidden
TC-009 timeline loads: every active stylist, today's bookings, current-time bar
TC-010 Next moves the timeline to tomorrow and loads its bookings
TC-011 clicking a booking block opens its quick actions, and View details opens the full booking
TC-012 clicking empty time opens the create form pre-filled with that stylist, time and a 30-minute block
TC-013 create walk-in: appears immediately as confirmed
TC-014 create break: a break block appears on the timeline
TC-015 confirming a pending booking turns it confirmed with a toast
TC-033 an admin walk-in that overlaps an existing booking is blocked with a clear message
TC-033b a walk-in inside another booking's rest window is allowed
TC-033c a break overlapping a booking is blocked
D1 two admins saving the same slot at the same moment: exactly one booking is created
D2 cancel shows an Undo toast; Undo restores; a taken slot refuses a restore
D3 the timeline follows the opening hours configured for that date
no deprecated Firestore persistence warning is logged
TC-016 search by name filters the list within 300ms
TC-017 search by phone number
TC-018 filter by stylist
D4 the list is ordered upcoming-first (soonest day first)
TC-019 bulk confirm: all selected pending bookings become confirmed, with ONE summary toast (D4)
TC-020 Export CSV downloads a file with the visible bookings
TC-021 client search shows visit count and total spend
TC-022 the client's history lists their bookings, newest first
TC-023 Book again pre-fills the create form with the client's name and phone
TC-024 a cancelled booking is not counted in total spend
TC-025 create a training session: appears under upcoming sessions with a toast
TC-026 a training session does not appear on the main timeline
TC-027 a session dated yesterday appears under Past Sessions
TC-028 a new stylist appears in the roster and the customer booking form
TC-029 deactivating a stylist hides them from customers; their bookings remain
TC-030 reactivating a stylist brings them back to the booking form
TC-031 editing a service price updates the booking form and logs the old price
TC-032 deactivating a service removes it from the booking form
D7 opening /admin/analytics directly (or refreshing it) stays on Analytics
SMOKE client books online -> owner approves -> overlapping admin walk-in is blocked
TC-034 a client can join the waitlist for a full day and the owner sees them
TC-035 the owner is notified of a new online booking, and the notification opens it
TC-036 closing a date in Manage -> Opening hours makes it unbookable for customers
with no `order` saved, the existing order is kept everywhere
the owner sees drag handles and Move up / Move down on every row; the ends are disabled
Move up changes the order, saves only `order`, and persists after reload
Move down works too
dragging a row by its handle reorders and persists
keyboard: Space picks a row up, an arrow moves it, Space drops it
a stylist added later (no order) goes after the ordered ones
if saving fails the order is put back and an error toast is shown
the customer page lists a service's phases and offers only starts where every busy block is free
the owner changes ONE booking's phases: live end time, saved to the booking and its projection, service untouched
shortening processing while another client is booked in the gap is refused, naming them
an edit that collides offers to move the return to the next free time
minimums: hands-on at least 15, 15-minute steps, and the booking must end before closing
Manage: the owner edits a service's default phases; existing bookings keep theirs
a walk-in can have its phases adjusted when it is created
TC-060 there are no Open slot buttons or labels; unavailable time is a muted fill
TC-061 hovering empty time highlights a 30-minute block snapped to 15 minutes; not over a booking, a break or where it will not fit
TC-062 dragging down 90 minutes opens the create form with the stylist, start and length
TC-063 dragging up grows the block upward
TC-064 a drag stops at the next booking, and at a break
TC-065 a plain click creates a 30-minute block
TC-066 Escape cancels a drag; nothing opens
TC-067 the past and a stylist's closed hours cannot be booked
TC-068 a booking with a processing gap draws solid / hatched / solid
TC-069 another client can be booked into the gap; the return stays reserved
TC-070 a drag in the gap stops at the return block; a booking that clashes with the return is refused
TC-071 dragging the edge of a phase changes that phase and moves the later ones
TC-072 a save that conflicts is rejected when it is made
TC-077 the create form: Client returns after processing adds processing and return phases
TC-073 touch: a long press then drag creates; a swipe scrolls; a tap previews with a Create button
TC-074 keyboard: arrows move the highlight, Shift+arrows extend it, Enter opens the form, Escape cancels
TC-075 a keyboard cursor on a booked time cannot be created and says why
TC-076 reduced motion: the highlight does not animate
TC-078 the owner sees Import clients in Manage; a stylist account does not
TC-079 the dry run reports counts and the error report has row numbers only
TC-080 confirming imports the clients as name + phone only; an existing client is untouched
TC-081 an imported client is recognised as a returning client in the walk-in form
TC-082 importing the same file again, as csv or xlsx, adds nobody
TC-083 the xlsx gives the same dry run as the csv
TC-084 rolling back removes only what that import created
TC-085 a wrong file is refused with a message, nothing is written
TC-095 a client Fresha has blocked cannot book online; rolling the import back lets them book again
TC-096 the walk-in form warns about a blocked client instead of calling them a returning client
TC-087 a request shows 'request received', the assigned stylist and the exact price; it is pending and holds the slot
TC-088 'Any Available Stylist' shows 'from $X' before sending, then the assigned stylist and exact price
TC-089 the owner approves a request and the booking is confirmed (with its availability projection)
TC-090 two customers choose the same slot at the same moment: exactly one request is accepted
TC-091 a legacy booking with stylist 'any' shows 'Needs stylist'; assigning one is conflict-checked and re-priced, then it can be approved
TC-092 approving a request whose slot has since been taken is refused with a clear message
TC-093 a blocked client is told to call the salon, and nothing is booked
TC-094 a third pending request from one phone number is refused
TC-097 a stylist sees only their own bookings; another stylist's are not readable
TC-098 search finds a client by a word of their name, the start of their name, or their mobile number
TC-099 the Today page's search sends someone straight into the directory with that search
TC-100 the client page shows history, last visit and the key numbers; also as a full page
TC-101 notes: add, pin (pinned first), see who wrote them, delete

TC-104 anonymising shows how many bookings it affects, then removes the personal data and keeps the bookings
TC-105 filters: lapsed, new, blocked, has a booking, has no-shows
